title.fil: Ang mga Tungkulin ng Isang BHW

modules.review_note: Individual role performances contribute to broader role explanation/application. A single role does not establish all three roles or the complete component. Preserve guidance on records, facts and local routes.

objective.fil: Maipapaliwanag ng BHW kung bakit mas malawak ang kanyang tungkulin sa ilalim ng UHC Act kaysa sa paghahatid lamang ng serbisyong pangkalusugan.
objective.en: The BHW can explain why their role under the UHC Act is wider than delivering health services alone.

indicators.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag ng BHW, gamit ang sariling salita, na mas malawak ang tungkulin niya kaysa paghatid ng serbisyo dahil ang direksyon ng UHC ay primary care at health promotion — at nakapagbibigay siya ng halimbawa ng gawaing hindi paghatid ng serbisyo.
indicators.observable_en: The BHW explains, in their own words, that their role is wider than service delivery because UHC's direction is primary care and health promotion — and gives an example of work that is not service delivery.
indicators.not_yet_fil: Nailalarawan ang trabaho bilang listahan lamang ng serbisyo (pagtimbang, pagbabakuna, pag-refer), at kapag tinanong tungkol sa UHC ay nasasabi lang na 'libre na ang PhilHealth' nang hindi naiuugnay sa sariling tungkulin.
indicators.not_yet_en: Describes the work as a list of services only (weighing, immunisation, referral), and when asked about UHC says only 'PhilHealth is free now' without connecting it to their own role.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Kusang binabanggit ang health promotion at pag-oorganisa bilang bahagi ng tungkulin, may kasamang halimbawa mula sa sariling barangay.
levels.kaya_na_en: Brings up health promotion and organising as part of the role unprompted, with an example from their own barangay.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nasasabi ang mas malawak na tungkulin kapag tinanong, pero serbisyo pa rin ang unang naiisip.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: States the wider role when asked, but service delivery is still the first thing that comes to mind.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nananatiling paghatid ng serbisyo lamang ang paglalarawan kahit may untag tungkol sa UHC.
levels.hindi_pa_en: The description stays at service delivery even when prompted about UHC.

objective.fil: Mailalarawan ng BHW ang tatlong tungkuling bumubuo sa kanyang papel bilang Health Education and Promotion Officer: Health Educator, Community Organizer, at Health Service Provider.
objective.en: The BHW can describe the three roles that make up their work as a Health Education and Promotion Officer: Health Educator, Community Organizer, and Health Service Provider.

indicators.observable_fil: Nasasabi at nailalarawan ng BHW ang tatlong tungkulin — Health Educator, Community Organizer, Health Service Provider — at kung ano ang ginagawa sa bawat isa, nang hindi tumitingin sa materyal.
indicators.observable_en: The BHW names and describes the three roles — Health Educator, Community Organizer, Health Service Provider — and what each involves, without looking at the material.
indicators.not_yet_fil: Nasasabi ang pangalan ng tatlo pero hindi mailarawan ang pagkakaiba ng ginagawa sa bawat isa, o pinagsasama ang Health Educator at Community Organizer sa iisang paglalarawan.
indicators.not_yet_en: Names the three but cannot describe how what they do differs, or collapses Health Educator and Community Organizer into a single description.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tatlo ang nasasabi nang tama, may sariling paglalarawan sa bawat isa na magkakaiba.
levels.kaya_na_en: Names all three correctly, with a distinct description of each in their own words.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Dalawa ang malinaw na nailalarawan; ang pangatlo ay kailangan pa ng untag.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Describes two clearly; the third needs prompting.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Isa lamang — kadalasan ang Health Service Provider — ang naiuugnay sa sariling trabaho.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Connects only one — usually Health Service Provider — to their own work.

objective.fil: Matutukoy ng BHW kung aling tungkulin ang kanyang ginagampanan sa isang partikular na sitwasyon sa barangay, at makapagbibigay siya ng halimbawa nito mula sa sariling karanasan.
objective.en: The BHW can identify which role they are performing in a given barangay situation, and give an example of it from their own experience.

indicators.observable_fil: Sa isang ibinigay na sitwasyon sa barangay, wastong natutukoy ng BHW kung aling tungkulin ang ginagampanan, at nakapagbibigay siya ng katulad na pangyayari mula sa sariling karanasan.
indicators.observable_en: Given a barangay situation, the BHW correctly identifies which role is being performed, and offers a comparable event from their own experience.
indicators.not_yet_fil: Natutukoy ang tungkulin sa mga halimbawang galing sa modyul, pero walang maibigay na pangyayari mula sa sariling barangay; o sinasabing 'hindi ko trabaho iyan' sa sitwasyong nasa saklaw ng tatlong tungkulin.
indicators.not_yet_en: Identifies the role in the module's own examples but offers nothing from their own barangay; or says 'that's not my job' about a situation that is within the three roles.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tama sa lahat ng sitwasyon, at may kusang ibinibigay na sariling halimbawa para sa bawat tungkulin.
levels.kaya_na_en: Correct on every situation, and volunteers an example of their own for each role.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama sa halos lahat, pero isang tungkulin lang ang may sariling halimbawa.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Correct on most, but has an example of their own for only one role.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nalilito sa pagitan ng tatlo, o iisang tungkulin lang ang itinuturo anuman ang sitwasyon.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Confuses the three, or names the same role regardless of the situation.

objective.fil: Maililista ng BHW ang mga talaan at dokumentong responsibilidad niya bilang health service provider, at kung saan napupunta ang bawat isa.
objective.en: The BHW can list the records and documents they are responsible for as a health service provider, and where each one goes.

indicators.observable_fil: Nabibilang ng BHW ang mga talaang hawak niya (household profile, master list, registry, mga form ng DOH o LGU) at nasasabi kung kanino napupunta ang bawat isa at para saan ito ginagamit.
indicators.observable_en: The BHW lists the records they keep (household profile, master list, registry, DOH or LGU forms) and states where each one goes and what it is used for.
indicators.not_yet_fil: Nabibilang ang mga papeles pero inilalarawan ang mga ito bilang 'requirement' o 'para sa midwife' lamang, nang hindi naiuugnay sa direksyon ng programa.
indicators.not_yet_en: Lists the paperwork but describes it as a 'requirement' or 'for the midwife' only, without connecting it to where a programme is directed.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Nabibilang ang mga talaan at naipapaliwanag kung paano nakakaapekto ang datos sa pagpili ng prayoridad ng programa.
levels.kaya_na_en: Lists the records and explains how the data affect which priorities a programme takes on.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nabibilang ang mga talaan at alam kung kanino ipinapasa, pero hindi pa naiuugnay sa paggamit ng datos.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Lists the records and knows who they go to, but does not yet connect them to how the data are used.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Isa o dalawang talaan lamang ang naaalala, at itinuturing na papeles na walang kinalaman sa serbisyo.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Recalls only one or two records, and treats them as paperwork unrelated to service.

fil: Maipaliwanag kung paano nagsasama ang pagtuturo, pag-oorganisa, at pagtulong sa serbisyo sa papel ng BHW.
en: Explain how education, organizing, and service support work together in the BHW role.

criteria.observable_fil: Maipaliwanag kung paano nagsasama ang pagtuturo, pag-oorganisa, at pagtulong sa serbisyo sa papel ng BHW.
criteria.observable_en: Explain how education, organizing, and service support work together in the BHW role.
criteria.not_yet_fil: Hindi pa maipaliwanag ang sagot sa sitwasyon.
criteria.not_yet_en: Cannot yet explain the response to the scenario.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipaliwanag nang wasto at walang gabay.
levels.kaya_na_en: Explains accurately without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naipaliwanag sa tulong ng tanong.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Explains with prompts.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Kailangan pang ipakita at pagsanayan.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Needs further demonstration and practice.

fil: Matukoy ang angkop na gawaing pang-edukasyon para sa iba’t ibang sektor at yugto ng buhay.
en: Identify education suited to different community groups and life stages.

criteria.observable_fil: Matukoy ang angkop na gawaing pang-edukasyon para sa iba’t ibang sektor at yugto ng buhay.
criteria.observable_en: Identify education suited to different community groups and life stages.
criteria.not_yet_fil: Hindi pa maipaliwanag ang sagot sa sitwasyon.
criteria.not_yet_en: Cannot yet explain the response to the scenario.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipaliwanag nang wasto at walang gabay.
levels.kaya_na_en: Explains accurately without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naipaliwanag sa tulong ng tanong.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Explains with prompts.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Kailangan pang ipakita at pagsanayan.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Needs further demonstration and practice.

fil: Sa sitwasyong may napansing suliranin sa purok, makapag-anyaya ng pakikilahok, maihiwalay ang obserbasyon sa hinala, at maituro kung paano ito dadalhin sa lokal na pagpaplano.
en: Given a concern observed in the neighborhood, invite participation, distinguish the observation from an assumption, and explain how to bring it into local planning.

criteria.observable_fil: Sa pagsasanay ng magkapares, nagbigay ng paanyaya ang BHW, umangkop sa tugon ng residente, nagsabi ng tiyak na obserbasyon nang walang hinalang sanhi, at pinangalanan ang lalapitan sa lokal na pagpaplano.
criteria.observable_en: In the paired role-play, the BHW invited participation, adapted to the resident's response, reported a specific observation without claiming a cause, and named whom to approach through local planning.
criteria.not_yet_fil: Hindi pa nakapagbigay ng paanyayang may puwang sa tugon ng residente o nakapaghiwalay ng nakita sa hinala.
criteria.not_yet_en: Has not yet made an invitation that allows a resident to respond or separated what was seen from an assumption.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Nagawa ang paanyaya, pagtugon, pag-uulat ng nakita, at pagtukoy ng lokal na lalapitan nang walang gabay.
levels.kaya_na_en: Invites, responds, reports what was seen, and names the local contact without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nagawa ang mga hakbang matapos tanungin kung ano ang nakita, kailan maaari ang residente, o kanino lalapit.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Completes the steps after prompts about what was seen, when the resident is available, or whom to approach.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nag-anunsyo lamang, hindi tumugon, naghahayag ng hinalang sanhi, o nangangako ng pondo kahit may gabay.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Only announces, does not respond, claims an unverified cause, or promises funding despite prompts.

fil: Sa residenteng humihingi ng tulong, matanong ang pangangailangan, maituro ang angkop na health worker at malinaw na susunod na hakbang, manatili sa loob ng pagsasanay, at masabi ang follow-up ayon sa tagubilin ng health team.
en: Given a resident seeking help, ask about the need, identify an appropriate health worker and clear next step, stay within training, and state the follow-up directed by the health team.

criteria.observable_fil: Matanong ang pangangailangan, maituro ang angkop na health worker at susunod na hakbang, humingi ng gabay kapag lampas sa pagsasanay, at masabi ang follow-up at pag-uulat.
criteria.observable_en: Ask about the need, identify an appropriate health worker and next step, seek guidance beyond training, and state follow-up and reporting.
criteria.not_yet_fil: Nagbibigay ng payong lampas sa pagsasanay o hindi makapagbigay ng malinaw na susunod na hakbang kahit may gabay.
criteria.not_yet_en: Gives advice beyond training or cannot give a clear next step even with prompting.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Nagagawa ang lahat ng hakbang nang walang gabay.
levels.kaya_na_en: Performs all steps without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nagagawa ang paggabay ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa saklaw o follow-up.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Guides appropriately but needs prompting about scope or follow-up.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Kailangan pang ipakita at pagsanayan ang ligtas na paggabay.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Needs demonstration and practice in safe guidance.

fil: Maitugma ang apat na uri ng talaan sa gamit nito at maipaliwanag kung kanino ihahatid ang kaugnay na impormasyon.
en: Match four record types to their purposes and explain who should receive relevant information.

criteria.observable_fil: Maitugma ang apat na tala sa tanong na sinasagot ng bawat isa; masuri ang hindi tiyak na entry at maipaliwanag ang tamang tatanggap at paraan ng pagpapasa.
criteria.observable_en: Match four records to the questions they answer; check an uncertain entry and explain the recipient and approved handoff route.
criteria.not_yet_fil: Napagpapalit ang master list at registry o nanghuhula ng kulang na detalye kahit may gabay.
criteria.not_yet_en: Confuses the master list with the registry or guesses missing details even with prompting.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naitutugma ang lahat at nailalarawan ang ligtas na pagpapasa nang walang gabay.
levels.kaya_na_en: Matches all four and describes a safe handoff without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang pagtutugma ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa paglinaw o tatanggap.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Matches the records but needs a prompt about verification or recipient.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Kailangan pang ipakita at pagsanayan ang pagpili at paglinaw ng tala.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Needs demonstration and practice in choosing and checking a record.

fil: Maipaliwanag ang mga papel na kailangan sa sitwasyon at makapagbigay ng maikling handover ayon sa tagubilin.
en: Explain the roles needed in a situation and give a short handover following an instruction.

criteria.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag ang tatlong tungkuling ginamit, nasusunod ang tagubilin, at naibibigay ang handover na may nakita, aktwal na ginawa, at kailangan pang aksyon nang walang imbentong konklusyon.
criteria.observable_en: Explains the three roles used, follows the instruction, and gives a handover with observation, actual action, and remaining need without an invented conclusion.
criteria.not_yet_fil: Nagdaragdag ng hindi napatunayang sanhi o diagnosis, o hindi maihiwalay ang nakita, ginawa, at kailangan kahit may gabay.
criteria.not_yet_en: Adds an unverified cause or diagnosis, or cannot separate observation, action, and need even with support.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Walang gabay naipapaliwanag ang tatlong tungkulin at pagsunod sa tagubilin; tugma ang tala at kumpletong handover, at tama ang tatanggap.
levels.kaya_na_en: Without prompts, explains the three roles and how the instruction was followed; the record and complete handover agree and reach the appropriate recipient.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Wasto ang pangunahing ulat ngunit may kulang na bahagi o tungkulin; nakukumpleto matapos ang tanong o gabay.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: The report is sound but misses a part or role; completes it after a question or prompt.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi maihiwalay ang obserbasyon sa hinala, o hindi masunod ang tagubilin kahit may gabay; kailangan ng demonstrasyon at muling pagsasanay.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Cannot separate observation from assumption or follow the instruction even with prompts; needs demonstration and further practice.

title.fil: Ang gawain at mas malawak na tungkulin

modules.review_note: Coverage and primary-care tasks jointly support the older combined goal-and-changes indicator. Local factual communication is not automatically a comparison of real implementation. Keep confirmed local information separate from promises.

objective.fil: Maipapaliwanag ng BHW ang pangunahing layunin ng Universal Health Care Act of 2019 at ang mga partikular na pagbabagong idinudulot nito sa sistemang pangkalusugan.
objective.en: The BHW can explain the main goal of the Universal Health Care Act of 2019 and the specific changes it brings to the health system.

indicators.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag ng BHW, gamit ang sariling salita, ang layunin ng UHC Act at hindi bababa sa tatlo sa apat na konkretong pagbabago nito (PhilHealth coverage, outpatient consult, primary care provider, referral system).
indicators.observable_en: The BHW explains, in their own words, the UHC Act's goal and at least three of its four concrete changes (PhilHealth coverage, outpatient consultation, primary care provider, referral system).
indicators.not_yet_fil: Nasasabi lamang na 'may bagong batas tungkol sa kalusugan' nang walang partikular na pagbabagong mababanggit, o inaakalang libre na ang lahat.
indicators.not_yet_en: Only says 'there's a new health law' with no specific change named, or assumes everything is now free.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipapaliwanag nang tama ang layunin at hindi bababa sa tatlong pagbabago, walang untag.
levels.kaya_na_en: Explains the goal and at least three changes correctly, unprompted.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naaalala ang layunin pero isa o dalawa lang sa apat na pagbabago ang natutukoy.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Recalls the goal but identifies only one or two of the four changes.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi maiugnay ang UHC Act sa anumang tiyak na pagbabago.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Cannot connect the UHC Act to any specific change at all.

objective.fil: Matutukoy ng BHW kung alin sa mga pagbabagong ito ang aktwal nang naramdaman sa kanyang sariling barangay, at alin pa ang hindi pa lubos na naipapatupad.
objective.en: The BHW can identify which of these changes are already felt in their own barangay, and which are not yet fully in place.

indicators.observable_fil: Nakapagbibigay ang BHW ng tiyak na paghahambing kung alin sa mga pagbabago ang naramdaman na sa sariling barangay at alin ang hindi pa, batay sa tunay na obserbasyon.
indicators.observable_en: The BHW gives a specific comparison of which changes are already felt in their own barangay and which are not yet, based on real observation.
indicators.not_yet_fil: Pangkalahatang sagot lamang ('marami na, may kaunti pa rin') nang walang tiyak na halimbawa mula sa sariling barangay.
indicators.not_yet_en: Gives only a general answer ('mostly, with a bit left') with no specific example from their own barangay.

levels.kaya_na_fil: May tiyak na halimbawa para sa hindi bababa sa dalawa sa apat na pagbabago, batay sa aktwal na obserbasyon.
levels.kaya_na_en: Gives a specific example for at least two of the four changes, based on actual observation.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May pangkalahatang ideya pero isang halimbawa lamang ang tiyak.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Has a general sense but only one example is specific.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi maihambing ang sitwasyon ng sariling barangay sa alinman sa apat na pagbabago.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Cannot compare their own barangay's situation to any of the four changes.

objective.fil: Makapagmumungkahi ang BHW ng isang tiyak na paraan para mapabuti pa ang pagpapatupad ng UHC sa kanyang barangay, at maipapaliwanag niya ito nang tama sa kapwa BHW o sa midwife.
objective.en: The BHW can propose one specific way to improve how UHC is carried out in their barangay, and explain it correctly to a fellow BHW or the midwife.

indicators.observable_fil: Naipapahayag ng BHW nang malinaw sa kapwa BHW o midwife ang isang tiyak na mungkahi para mapabuti ang pagpapatupad ng UHC, at nakikinig din sa naibabalik na puna.
indicators.observable_en: The BHW clearly states one specific suggestion to a fellow BHW or the midwife for improving how UHC is carried out, and listens to the feedback that comes back.
indicators.not_yet_fil: Nananatili sa reklamo ('hindi maganda ang takbo dito') nang walang partikular na mungkahi, o hindi ito talagang naipaparating sa iba.
indicators.not_yet_en: Stays at complaint level ('this isn't working well here') with no specific suggestion, or never actually raises it with anyone else.

levels.kaya_na_fil: May tiyak na mungkahi na naipahayag nang malinaw, at may buod ng napag-usapan pagkatapos.
levels.kaya_na_en: States a specific suggestion clearly, and can summarize what was discussed afterward.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May mungkahi pero kailangan pa ng tulong para maipahayag ito nang malinaw sa iba.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Has a suggestion but needs help articulating it clearly to someone else.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi lumalampas sa reklamo o hinaing.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Never moves past complaint or grievance.

objective.fil: Makapagsisimula ang BHW ng isang maliit at konkretong hakbang tungo sa pagsasakatuparan ng naisip niyang pagpapabuti.
objective.en: The BHW can take one small, concrete first step toward putting that improvement into practice.

indicators.observable_fil: Nakapagbibigay ang BHW ng isang maliit, konkreto, at magagawa nang hakbang bilang unang aksyon — hindi malawak o abstract na plano.
indicators.observable_en: The BHW names one small, concrete, doable step as a first action — not a broad or abstract plan.
indicators.not_yet_fil: Ang naisip na hakbang ay masyadong malaki o abstract ('babaguhin ko ang buong sistema') at walang malinaw na unang gagawin.
indicators.not_yet_en: The proposed step is too large or abstract ('I'll change the whole system') with no clear first action.

levels.kaya_na_fil: May tiyak na hakbang na magagawa sa loob ng isang linggo, may petsa o pagkakataong sinabi.
levels.kaya_na_en: Has a specific step doable within a week, with a stated date or occasion.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May pangkalahatang direksyon pero hindi pa tiyak kung ano at kailan ang unang gagawin.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Has a general direction but is not yet specific about what the first action is or when.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nananatili sa antas ng ideya nang walang balak na aksyon.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Stays at the level of an idea, with no intended action.

fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: layunin at saklaw ng uhc.
en: Explain and apply in a situation: uhc purpose and coverage.

criteria.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag sa residente ang layunin ng UHC at awtomatikong NHIP inclusion, at natutukoy ang benepisyo, provider, at hakbang na dapat tiyakin bago mangakong walang bayad.
criteria.observable_en: Explains UHC's aim and automatic NHIP inclusion to a resident, and names the benefit, provider, and steps to check before promising no charge.
criteria.not_yet_fil: Ipinapangakong libre ang lahat o hindi maipaliwanag ang dapat tiyakin.
criteria.not_yet_en: Promises that everything is free or cannot explain what needs checking.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipapaliwanag ang dalawang punto at ang susunod na hakbang nang walang untag.
levels.kaya_na_en: Explains both points and the next step without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang direksiyon ngunit kailangan ng gabay upang tukuyin ang dapat tiyakin.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Has the right direction but needs prompting to name what to check.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi pa tumpak ang paliwanag o nangangako nang walang pagtitiyak.
levels.hindi_pa_en: The explanation is inaccurate or promises coverage without checking.

fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: primary care at referral.
en: Explain and apply in a situation: primary care and referral.

criteria.observable_fil: Sa usapan kay Mang Ernesto, malinaw na tinatanong ng BHW ang napiling clinic, benepisyo at proseso, at lokal na referral contact kung irekomenda ng clinician.
criteria.observable_en: In the Mang Ernesto scenario, the BHW clearly checks the chosen clinic, benefit and process, and local referral contact if a clinician recommends referral.
criteria.not_yet_fil: Naghuhula ng clinic o referral destination, nangangako ng serbisyo, o gumagawa ng klinikal na pasya.
criteria.not_yet_en: Guesses a clinic or referral destination, promises a service, or makes a clinical decision.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Nasasabi ang tatlong dapat tiyakin at malinaw ang hangganan ng papel ng BHW nang walang tulong.
levels.kaya_na_en: Names all three things to confirm and the BHW role boundary without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Alam na dapat magtanong sa health team ngunit kailangan ng gabay sa kung ano ang itatanong.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Knows to ask the health team but needs prompting about what to ask.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nagbibigay ng tiyak na clinic o referral na walang kumpirmasyon, o nagpapasya para sa clinician.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Names an unconfirmed clinic or referral, or decides for the clinician.

fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: health board at health promotion.
en: Explain and apply in a situation: health boards and health promotion.

criteria.observable_en: Gives a factual summary and protects resident details. Gives a checked health-promotion response and checks understanding. Asks a specific question of a locally confirmed contact, respects decision authority and names follow-up.
criteria.observable_fil: Malinaw ang buod at maingat sa personal na detalye. Nasuri ang health-promotion response at sinusuri ang pagkaunawa. Tiyak ang tanong sa nakumpirmang lokal na contact, malinaw ang awtoridad at may follow-up.
criteria.not_yet_en: Invents causes or discloses identifying health details. Repeats unconfirmed activity information as fact. Announces unauthorised policy/approval or promises an invented board route.
criteria.not_yet_fil: Nag-iimbento ng dahilan o naglalantad ng makikilalang health detail. Inuulit bilang tiyak ang hindi pa kumpirmadong impormasyon. Nagpapahayag ng patakaran/approval nang walang awtoridad o nag-iimbento ng ruta sa board.

levels.kaya_na_en: States the recurring question, timing and uncertainty without prompting; omits unnecessary identifying details. Uses team-checked material or clearly says details need confirmation; explains simply and asks the resident to describe understanding. Identifies who can confirm and receive the suggestion; asks who can decide and how/when feedback will arrive without prompting.
levels.kaya_na_fil: Nasasabi ang tanong, panahon at hindi pa tiyak nang walang gabay; walang di-kailangang makikilalang detalye. Gumagamit ng nasuring materyal o nagsasabing tiyakin pa; payak ang paliwanag at pinasasabi ang pagkaunawa. Tinutukoy ang makapagkukumpirma at tatanggap; tinatanong ang may pasya at paano/kailan ang tugon nang walang gabay.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Needs a prompt to separate facts from guesses or shorten the summary. Needs prompting to check material, explain simply or check understanding. Knows to ask the team but needs prompts for the contact, specific question or follow-up.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Kailangan ng gabay upang ihiwalay ang fakta sa hinala o paikliin ang buod. Kailangan ng gabay sa materyal, payak na paliwanag o pagsuri sa pagkaunawa. Alam na magtatanong sa team ngunit kailangan ng gabay sa contact, tanong o follow-up.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Invents causes or discloses identifying health details. Repeats unconfirmed activity information as fact. Announces unauthorised policy/approval or promises an invented board route.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nag-iimbento ng dahilan o naglalantad ng makikilalang health detail. Inuulit bilang tiyak ang hindi pa kumpirmadong impormasyon. Nagpapahayag ng patakaran/approval nang walang awtoridad o nag-iimbento ng ruta sa board.

fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: maliit na hakbang sa pagpapabuti.
en: Explain and apply in a situation: one practical improvement.

criteria.observable_fil: Sa hindi nagpapakilalang lokal na halimbawa, nagmumungkahi ang BHW ng isang maliit na pagpapabuti: obserbasyon, kumpirmasyon at pahintulot, konkretong unang hakbang, kayang oras/gamit, at pagbabalik gamit ang feedback.
criteria.observable_en: In a non-identifying local example, the BHW proposes a small improvement with an observation, confirmation and agreement, a concrete first step, feasible time/materials, and a review using feedback.
criteria.not_yet_fil: Nangangako ng hindi kumpirmadong benepisyo, nagpapalit ng serbisyo/patakaran nang mag-isa, o walang konkretong unang hakbang at paraan ng pagbabalik.
criteria.not_yet_en: Promises an unconfirmed benefit, changes services/policy alone, or gives no concrete first step and review method.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Walang prompt: inilalarawan ang obserbasyon, pinatutunayan sa tamang contact ang impormasyon at pahintulot, at nagsasaad ng maliit na gawain, responsable, kayang oras/gamit, petsa at palatandaang babalikan; binabago ang plano ayon sa feedback.
levels.kaya_na_en: Without prompting: describes the observation, checks information and agreement with the responsible contact, and states a small action, owner, feasible time/materials, review date and indicator; revises the plan using feedback.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nais makipag-usap at maliit ang mungkahi, ngunit kailangan ng prompt upang tukuyin ang pahintulot, responsable, oras/gamit o palatandaang babalikan.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Wants to discuss a small proposal but needs prompts to specify agreement, responsibility, time/materials or the review indicator.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nangangako ng hindi kumpirmadong benepisyo, nagpapalit ng serbisyo/patakaran nang mag-isa, o walang konkretong unang hakbang at paraan ng pagbabalik.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Promises an unconfirmed benefit, changes services/policy alone, or gives no concrete first step and review method.

title.fil: Panimulang talakayan at paliwanag sa UHC
Mga Polisiya sa Barangay Health Station
title.en: Policies at the Barangay Health Station

modules.review_note: Resolve memorized law numbers versus applied policy reasons, refusal alternatives versus prohibited workarounds, and combined lesson actions versus the guide's request for separate scores. Do not apply the older cooperation anchor automatically.

objective.fil: Matutukoy ng BHW kung aling apat na polisiya ang nagbabawal sa promosyon ng gatas, gamot, at plastic sa loob ng barangay health station, at maipapaliwanag niya kung bakit umiiral ang bawat isa.
objective.en: The BHW can identify the four policies that prohibit promoting milk, medicine, and plastics inside the barangay health station, and explain why each one exists.

indicators.observable_fil: Nasasabi ng BHW ang apat na polisiya (EO 51, RA 10028, AO 2015-0053, DC 2021-0486) at ang partikular na ipinagbabawal o inaatasan ng bawat isa, nang hindi tumitingin sa materyal.
indicators.observable_en: The BHW names the four policies (EO 51, RA 10028, AO 2015-0053, DC 2021-0486) and what each one specifically prohibits or requires, without looking at the material.
indicators.not_yet_fil: Naaalala lamang na 'may bawal na promosyon' nang hindi maitukoy kung aling batas ang saklaw ng gatas, gamot, o plastic.
indicators.not_yet_en: Only recalls that 'promotion is banned' without being able to say which law covers milk, medicine, or plastic.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tama ang apat, kasama ang partikular na saklaw ng bawat isa, walang untag.
levels.kaya_na_en: Correctly states all four, including each one's specific scope, unprompted.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang dalawa o tatlo, pero nalilito sa saklaw ng natitira.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Correct on two or three, but confuses the scope of the rest.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Isa lamang o wala ang tamang natutukoy.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Correctly identifies only one, or none.

objective.fil: Maipapaliwanag ng BHW ang inaasahan sa kanya ayon sa RA 10028 — ang pagsusulong ng breastfeeding sa halip na pag-promote ng milk substitute.
objective.en: The BHW can explain what RA 10028 expects of them — promoting breastfeeding instead of promoting milk substitutes.

indicators.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag ng BHW na ang RA 10028 ay hindi lang pagbabawal kundi aktibong pag-atas na isulong ang breastfeeding at magkaroon ng lactation station.
indicators.observable_en: The BHW explains that RA 10028 is not only a prohibition but an active requirement to promote breastfeeding and to have a lactation station.
indicators.not_yet_fil: Inilalarawan ang RA 10028 bilang bawal lang sa gatas, hindi nailalagay ang aktibong pag-atas na isulong ang breastfeeding.
indicators.not_yet_en: Describes RA 10028 only as a ban on milk, without connecting it to the active requirement to promote breastfeeding.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Malinaw na naiiba ang RA 10028 (aktibong pag-atas) sa EO 51 (pagbabawal), may sariling halimbawa.
levels.kaya_na_en: Clearly distinguishes RA 10028 (active requirement) from EO 51 (prohibition), with an own example.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naiiba ang dalawa kapag tinanong, pero hindi kusang binabanggit.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Distinguishes the two when asked, but doesn't bring it up unprompted.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Pinagsasama ang RA 10028 at EO 51 bilang iisang bawal lamang.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Collapses RA 10028 and EO 51 into a single prohibition.

objective.fil: Makapagpapakita ang BHW ng magalang na paraan ng pagtanggi kapag inalok ng regalo o insentibo ng isang kumpanya kapalit ng pag-promote ng produkto nito.
objective.en: The BHW can demonstrate a respectful way to decline when a company offers a gift or incentive in exchange for promoting its product.

indicators.observable_fil: Naipapakita ng BHW, sa isang role-play o aktwal na sitwasyon, ang pagtanggi na kumikilala sa intensyon ng bisita, naglalahad ng batayang polisiya, at nag-aalok ng ibang paraan ng pakikipagtulungan.
indicators.observable_en: In a role-play or an actual situation, the BHW shows a refusal that acknowledges the visitor's intent, states the policy basis, and offers another way to cooperate.
indicators.not_yet_fil: Tumatanggi nang walang paliwanag, o hindi talaga tumatanggi at tinatanggap ang alok.
indicators.not_yet_en: Declines with no explanation, or does not actually decline and accepts the offer.

levels.kaya_na_fil: May tatlong bahagi ang pagtanggi — pagkilala, batayan, alternatibo — nang natural at hindi robotic.
levels.kaya_na_en: The refusal has all three parts — acknowledgment, basis, alternative — delivered naturally, not robotically.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tumatanggi at may batayan, pero nakakalimutan ang alternatibong pakikipagtulungan.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Declines with a basis, but forgets to offer an alternative form of cooperation.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Tumatanggap ng alok, o tumatanggi nang walang ipinaliwanag na dahilan.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Accepts the offer, or declines with no stated reason.

objective.fil: Makapagmumungkahi ang BHW ng isang praktikal na paraan para maging mas episyente ang paggamit ng resources — tubig, kuryente, o gamit — sa kanilang barangay health station.
objective.en: The BHW can propose one practical way to use resources — water, electricity, or supplies — more efficiently at their barangay health station.

indicators.observable_fil: Nakapagbibigay ang BHW ng tiyak na mungkahi para sa mas episyenteng paggamit ng resources sa BHS, kasama ang partikular na dahilan kung bakit ito makakatulong.
indicators.observable_en: The BHW gives a specific suggestion for using resources more efficiently at the BHS, with a specific reason why it would help.
indicators.not_yet_fil: Pangkalahatang mungkahi lamang ('dapat mag-ipon ng resources') nang walang tiyak na bagay na babaguhin.
indicators.not_yet_en: Only a general suggestion ('we should conserve resources') with no specific thing to change.

levels.kaya_na_fil: May tiyak na mungkahi at malinaw na dahilan, kayang sabihin sa midwife o kapwa BHW.
levels.kaya_na_en: Has a specific suggestion and a clear reason, ready to say to the midwife or a fellow BHW.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May tiyak na naisip pero hindi pa maayos maisalarawan ang dahilan.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Has something specific in mind but cannot yet clearly articulate the reason.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nananatili sa pangkalahatang mungkahi nang walang tiyak na target.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Stays at a general suggestion with no specific target.

fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: pagkilala sa alok ng kumpanya.
en: Explain and apply in a situation: recognizing a company offer.

criteria.observable_fil: Sa unbranded offer, natutukoy ang produkto, promosyon, lugar/kausap at insentibo; naihihiwalay ang polisiya, humihinto at idinudulog ang factual na detalye sa namamahala.
criteria.observable_en: In an unbranded offer, identifies product, promotion, place/audience and inducement; distinguishes policy topics, pauses and routes factual details to the supervisor.
criteria.not_yet_fil: Tumatanggap, nagpapaskil o namimigay, nag-aapruba nang mag-isa, o hindi tinitingnan ang saklaw at detalye.
criteria.not_yet_en: Accepts, displays or distributes, approves independently, or fails to check scope and details.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Natutukoy ang apat na detalye at tamang koordinasyon nang walang prompt; malinaw ang hangganan ng BHW.
levels.kaya_na_en: Identifies all four details and correct coordination without prompting; clearly respects the BHW role boundary.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nakikilala ang concern ngunit kailangan ng prompt sa saklaw, kausap o unang pagdulog.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Recognizes the concern but needs prompts about scope, audience or the first coordination step.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Tumatanggap o nag-aapruba nang mag-isa, o pinapantay ang lahat ng alok nang walang pagsusuri.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Accepts or approves independently, or treats all offers as identical without checking.

fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: breastfeeding at kapaligiran.
en: Explain and apply in a situation: breastfeeding and the environment.

criteria.observable_fil: Sa dalawang role-play, nakikinig nang magalang at may privacy, kinukumpirma ang sinanay na contact at lugar, ipinapasa sa supervisor ang non-clinical na alternatibo, at pinoprotektahan ang sterile at kinakailangang clinical supplies.
criteria.observable_en: In both role-plays, listens respectfully with privacy, confirms the trained contact and space, asks the supervisor about the non-clinical alternative, and protects sterile and necessary clinical supplies.
criteria.not_yet_fil: Nangangako ng hindi kumpirmadong pasilidad o contact, pinipilit ang feeding choice, o nag-aalis o nagre-reuse ng clinical supplies nang kusa.
criteria.not_yet_en: Promises an unconfirmed facility or contact, imposes a feeding choice, or independently removes or reuses clinical supplies.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipapakita ang lahat ng hakbang sa dalawang sitwasyon nang walang prompt at malinaw ang hangganan ng BHW at institusyon.
levels.kaya_na_en: Demonstrates every step in both scenarios without prompting and distinguishes BHW and institution responsibilities.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Magalang at nakikilala ang safety boundary ngunit kailangan ng prompt sa privacy, contact, lugar o supervisor confirmation.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Uses respectful language and recognizes the safety boundary but needs a prompt on privacy, contact, space or supervisor confirmation.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: May hindi kumpirmadong pangako, pamimilit o sariling pagbabago sa clinical supplies; kailangan munang itama bago ulitin ang role-play.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Makes an unconfirmed promise, imposes a choice or changes clinical supplies independently; needs correction before repeating the role-play.

fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: magalang na pagtanggi.
en: Explain and apply in a situation: declining respectfully.

criteria.observable_fil: 1. Gumagamit ng magalang na tono at malinaw na tinutukoy ang hindi tatanggapin, ipapaskil o ipamimigay. 2. Itinutugma ang dahilan sa formula o prescription samples at inuulit ang hangganan nang walang workaround o pangakong exception. 3. Nagbibigay ng factual na handover sa natiyak na namamahala, kasama ang sariling tugon, walang datos ng pasyente.
criteria.observable_en: 1. Uses a respectful tone and explicitly names what will not be accepted, displayed or distributed. 2. Matches the reason to formula or prescription samples and repeats the boundary without a workaround or promised exception. 3. Gives a factual handover to the confirmed supervisor, including their response, without patient data.
criteria.not_yet_fil: 1. Malabo ang pagtanggi o tinatanggap pa rin ang mga bagay. 2. Maling polisiya ang gamit o pumapayag sa alternatibong promosyon. 3. Walang pag-ulat o haka-haka at personal na datos ang ulat.
criteria.not_yet_en: 1. Refusal is ambiguous or the items are still accepted. 2. Uses the wrong policy or agrees to alternative promotion. 3. Omits reporting or includes speculation and patient data.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipapakita ang tatlong kilos nang walang prompt: malinaw na pagtanggi, tamang dahilan/matatag na hangganan, factual na ulat.
levels.kaya_na_en: Demonstrates all three without prompting: clear refusal, accurate reason/firm boundary, factual report.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tamang direksiyon ngunit kailangan ng prompt sa isa o higit pang kilos.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Correct direction but needs a prompt for one or more actions.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Tumatanggap, may workaround, maling dahilan, o walang factual na ulat.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Accepts, arranges a workaround, gives a wrong reason, or omits factual reporting.

fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: polisiya at paggamit ng rekurso.
en: Explain and apply in a situation: policies and resource use.

criteria.observable_fil: Sa dalawang card: (1) inilalarawan ang tiyak na resource concern nang factual; (2) tinutukoy ang polisiya, responsable at service/safety needs na dapat tiyakin; (3) ipinapaalam ang angkop na unang hakbang bago pagbabago, walang sariling cut, paglilipat o repair.
criteria.observable_en: In both cards: (1) describes the specific resource concern factually; (2) identifies the policy, responsible person and service/safety needs to check; (3) communicates an appropriate first step before changes, without independent cuts, reallocation or repairs.
criteria.not_yet_fil: Kumikilos bago tiyakin ang requirements, nagtatabi ng supplies nang kusa, nag-iimbento ng savings o hindi matukoy ang contact at tuntunin.
criteria.not_yet_en: Acts before checking requirements, sets supplies aside independently, invents savings or cannot identify the contact and rule.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipapakita ang tatlong kilos sa dalawang card nang walang prompt at malinaw ang hangganan ng tungkulin.
levels.kaya_na_en: Demonstrates all three actions in both cards without prompts and explains role limits.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tamang direksiyon ngunit kailangan ng prompt sa factual na tala, requirements o pakikipag-ugnayan bago pagbabago.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Appropriate direction but needs prompts for the factual record, requirements or coordination before changes.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: May sariling pagbabago o unsupported cut, o hindi matukoy ang dapat tiyakin; itama at ulitin bago masabing kaya na.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Makes an independent change or unsupported cut, or cannot identify what to check; correct and repeat before rating proficient.

fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: isang mungkahing maisasagawa.
en: Explain and apply in a situation: one workable suggestion.

criteria.observable_fil: Gamitin ang apat na linyang cue card: obserbasyon → panukala at dahilan → checks/contact → napagkasunduang follow-up. Magmodelo ng panukala. Palitan ang pangkalahatang reklamo ng tiyak na concern, saka tukuyin ang kilos na walang pahintulot o unsupported promise. Ulitin sa gustong wika, bawasan ang prompt, at muling obserbahan ang dalawang card matapos ang feedback. Kung hindi alam ang contact, kumpirmahin sa health team at magkasundo sa practice follow-up; huwag mag-imbento ng pahintulot.
criteria.observable_en: Use a four-line cue card: observation → proposal and reason → checks/contact → agreed follow-up. Model one proposal. Have the learner replace a general complaint with a specific concern, then identify any unauthorized action or unsupported promise. Let them repeat in their preferred language, fade prompts, and re-observe both cards after feedback. If a local contact is unknown, help confirm it through the health team and agree a practice follow-up; do not invent authority.
criteria.not_yet_fil: Nagpapatupad bago may pahintulot, nangangako ng approval o savings, o walang tiyak na panukala at follow-up.
criteria.not_yet_en: Implements before permission, promises approval or savings, or cannot state a specific proposal and follow-up.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipapakita ang tatlong kilos sa dalawang card nang walang prompt at malinaw ang hangganan ng tungkulin.
levels.kaya_na_en: Demonstrates all three actions on both cards without prompts and explains role limits.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Praktikal ang panukala ngunit kailangan ng prompt sa concern, checks o napagkasunduang follow-up.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Proposal is feasible but needs prompts for the concern, checks or agreed follow-up.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: May kilos na walang pahintulot o unsupported promise, o hindi makabuo ng tiyak na panukala; itama at ulitin.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Makes an unauthorized change or unsupported promise, or cannot form a specific proposal; correct and repeat.

modules.review_note: Use fictional bounded explanations and verification questions. The legacy rubric asks for actual personal accreditation/standing and unaided recall in places; do not infer eligibility or require disclosure from the lesson practice.

objective.fil: Maipapaliwanag ng BHW ang legal na batayan ng kanyang tungkulin ayon sa RA 7883, at matutukoy niya kung sino ang nagbibigay ng akreditasyon bago siya opisyal na makapagsimula sa gawain.
objective.en: The BHW can explain the legal basis of their role under RA 7883, and identify who accredits a BHW before they can officially begin their work.

indicators.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag ng BHW, gamit ang sariling salita, na ang kanilang tungkulin ay may legal na batayan (RA 7883) at sila ay akreditado ng local health board.
indicators.observable_en: The BHW explains, in their own words, that their duty has a legal basis (RA 7883) and that they are accredited by the local health board.
indicators.not_yet_fil: Naiiba ang paliwanag sa 'boluntir lang kasi gusto kong tumulong' nang walang binanggit na legal na batayan o proseso ng akreditasyon.
indicators.not_yet_en: The explanation stays at 'I just volunteer because I want to help,' with no mention of a legal basis or accreditation process.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipapaliwanag nang tama at may kumpiyansa, kahit hindi tinatanong.
levels.kaya_na_en: Explains it correctly and confidently, even unprompted.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naaalala lang kapag may untag na tanong ('saan ba galing ang tungkulin mo?').
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Only recalls it when prompted ('where does your duty come from?').
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi maiugnay ang tungkulin sa anumang legal na batayan.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Cannot connect the duty to any legal basis at all.

objective.fil: Maililista ng BHW ang mga benepisyong maaari niyang matanggap sa ilalim ng RA 7883, at matutukoy niya kung ano ang kailangan bago siya maging eligible dito.
objective.en: The BHW can list the benefits available to them under RA 7883, and identify what is required before they are eligible for these.

indicators.observable_fil: Nailalarawan ng BHW ang mga benepisyong nakasaad sa RA 7883 at kung ano ang kailangan bago maging eligible dito, nang hindi tumitingin sa materyal.
indicators.observable_en: The BHW describes the benefits named in RA 7883 and what is required to become eligible for them, without looking at the material.
indicators.not_yet_fil: Naaalala lamang na 'may benepisyo raw' nang hindi matukoy ang mga partikular na ito o ang rehistrasyong kailangan.
indicators.not_yet_en: Only recalls 'there are supposedly benefits' without naming the specific ones or the registration required.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Nailalarawan ang hindi bababa sa apat na benepisyo at ang rehistrasyong kailangan, walang untag.
levels.kaya_na_en: Describes at least four benefits and the registration required, unprompted.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May maalala pero dalawa o tatlo lamang, at hindi nauugnay sa rehistrasyon.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Recalls only two or three, and doesn't connect them to registration.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Isa o wala ang matukoy na benepisyo.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Identifies one or none of the benefits.

objective.fil: Maipapaliwanag ng BHW ang mga kondisyon ng BHW Eligibility (BHWE) sa Civil Service, at masusuri niya kung siya ay kwalipikado na o hindi pa.
objective.en: The BHW can explain the conditions for BHW Eligibility (BHWE) in the Civil Service, and assess whether they are already qualified or not yet.

indicators.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag ng BHW ang apat na kondisyon ng BHWE, at wastong nasusuri niya ang sariling katayuan laban sa bawat isa.
indicators.observable_en: The BHW explains BHWE's four conditions, and correctly assesses their own standing against each one.
indicators.not_yet_fil: Naiiba ang BHWE sa pangkalahatang akreditasyon, o hindi maisa-isa ang apat na kondisyon.
indicators.not_yet_en: Confuses BHWE with general accreditation, or cannot list the four conditions.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tama ang apat na kondisyon at may tapat na sariling pagsusuri sa bawat isa.
levels.kaya_na_en: States all four conditions correctly, with an honest self-assessment against each.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang dalawa o tatlo sa apat, kailangan pa ng untag para sa natitira.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Correct on two or three of the four, needs prompting for the rest.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Isa o wala ang tamang natutukoy na kondisyon.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Correctly identifies one condition or none.

objective.fil: Makapagpapakita ang BHW ng kalmado at matiyagang pag-uugali kapag humaharap sa mabagal na proseso ng rehistrasyon o pag-follow-up sa isang benepisyo.
objective.en: The BHW can demonstrate calm, patient behavior when facing a slow registration process or when following up on a benefit.

indicators.observable_fil: Sa isang role-play o aktwal na sitwasyon, nakapagtatanong ang BHW nang kalmado at may tiyak na tanong sa halip na reklamo, kapag humaharap sa pagkaantala.
indicators.observable_en: In a role-play or an actual situation, the BHW asks a calm, specific question rather than complaining, when facing a delay.
indicators.not_yet_fil: Nananahimik hanggang sa maantala nang malaki, o direktang nagrereklamo nang walang tiyak na hinihingi.
indicators.not_yet_en: Stays silent until badly delayed, or complains outright with no specific ask.

levels.kaya_na_fil: May tiyak na tanong na nagpapakita ng kalmado at propesyonal na pag-follow-up, kahit sa mahabang paghihintay.
levels.kaya_na_en: Asks a specific question that shows calm, professional follow-up, even after a long wait.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nag-fo-follow-up pero minsan nagiging emosyonal o hindi tiyak ang tanong.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Follows up, but sometimes becomes emotional or the question isn't specific.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nananahimik nang walang follow-up, o direktang nagagalit.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Stays silent with no follow-up, or becomes visibly upset.

title.en: The legal basis of the role

fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: legal na batayan ng tungkulin.
en: Explain and apply in a situation: the legal basis of the role.

criteria.observable_fil: Sa dalawang fictional case, ipinaliliwanag ang pagsasanay, boluntaryong primary health care at akreditasyon ayon sa RA 7883; pinapangalanan ang local health board at inihihiwalay ang support; pumipili ng contact/ebidensiya sa pag-verify nang walang unsupported claim.
criteria.observable_en: On both fictional cases, explains training, voluntary community primary health care and accreditation under RA 7883; identifies the local health board and distinguishes support; chooses a contact/evidence verification step without unsupported claims.
criteria.not_yet_fil: Ginagawang akreditasyon ang karanasan o nangangako ng benepisyo/appointment; kulang ang batayan, awtoridad o pag-verify.
criteria.not_yet_en: Treats experience as accreditation or promises benefits/appointment; lacks the legal basis, authority or verification.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipapaliwanag ang tatlong legal na bahagi, tamang awtoridad at hakbang sa pag-verify sa dalawang kaso nang walang prompt.
levels.kaya_na_en: Explains all three legal elements, the proper authority and verification step on both cases without prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang direksiyon ngunit kailangan ng prompt sa legal na bahagi, awtoridad o contact/ebidensiya.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Direction is sound but needs prompts for legal elements, authority or contact/evidence.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Ipinapalagay ang katayuan o benepisyo nang walang ebidensiya, o hindi maipaliwanag ang batayan/awtoridad; itama at ulitin.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Assumes status or benefits without evidence, or cannot explain basis/authority; correct and repeat.

fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: benepisyo at mga kondisyon.
en: Explain and apply in a situation: benefits and conditions.

criteria.observable_fil: Naipapangalan at naipapaliwanag ang anim na kategorya gamit ang listahan; naihihiwalay ang katayuan/rehistrasyon at specific conditions; nakapipili ng verification sa tamang awtoridad/contact nang walang garantiya, imbentong quota o pagsisi.
criteria.observable_en: Names and explains the six categories using the reference list; distinguishes status/registration and specific conditions; chooses verification with the proper authority/contact without guarantees, invented quotas or blame.
criteria.not_yet_fil: Nangangako pa rin ng awtomatikong pantay na bayad o credential-only entitlement, nag-iimbento ng quota o naninisi, o hindi maiugnay ang benepisyo sa verification.
criteria.not_yet_en: Still promises automatic equal payment or credential-only entitlement, invents quotas or blames non-recipients, or cannot connect the benefit with verification.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tamang kategorya, shared at specific conditions, at tiyak na verification nang walang untag o pangako.
levels.kaya_na_en: Accurate categories, shared and specific conditions, and specific verification without prompts or promises.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang direksiyon ngunit kailangan ng untag sa kondisyon, provider o ebidensiya.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Correct direction but needs prompts for conditions, provider or evidence.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi pa maiugnay ang benepisyo sa kondisyon at verification, o nagpapatuloy ang garantiya, imbentong quota o pagsisi.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Cannot yet connect benefits with conditions and verification, or persists with guarantees, invented quotas or blame.

fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: pag-unawa sa bhwe.
en: Explain and apply in a situation: understanding bhwe.

criteria.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag ang apat na pangkat ng BHWE conditions, naihihiwalay ang kabuuang serbisyo sa qualifying accredited service, at nakabubuo ng tiyak na CSC verification question tungkol sa ebidensiya/uncertainty nang walang pangako ng eligibility o appointment.
criteria.observable_en: Explains the four BHWE condition groups, distinguishes total service from qualifying accredited service, and forms a specific CSC question about evidence/uncertainty without promising eligibility or appointment.
criteria.not_yet_fil: Itinuturing pa rin na sapat ang accreditation, total years o JO/COS label, o nangangako ng BHWE/trabaho nang walang kondisyon at verification.
criteria.not_yet_en: Still treats accreditation, total years or a JO/COS label as sufficient, or promises BHWE/a job without conditions and verification.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tamang kondisyon, accredited-service count at uncertainty, at tiyak na CSC verification nang walang untag o pangako.
levels.kaya_na_en: Accurate conditions, accredited-service count and uncertainty, and specific CSC verification without prompts or promises.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang direksiyon ngunit kailangan ng untag sa edukasyon, service period, arrangement o ebidensiya/contact.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Correct direction but needs prompts for education, service period, arrangement or evidence/contact.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi pa naihihiwalay ang kondisyon at serbisyo, nagpapasya mula sa label, o nagpapatuloy ang pangako ng approval/appointment.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Cannot yet distinguish conditions and service, decides from a label, or persists with promises of approval/appointment.

fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: proseso ng akreditasyon.
en: Explain and apply in a situation: the accreditation process.

criteria.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag at nailalapat ang papel ng board at komite sa kathang sitwasyon, naihihiwalay ang alam sa kulang na pasya/tala, at nakabubuo ng tiyak na lokal na tanong tungkol sa proseso at susunod na hakbang nang walang pag-aangkin ng akreditasyon.
criteria.observable_en: Explains and applies board and committee roles in a fictional situation, separates known facts from a missing decision/record, and forms a specific local process/next-step question without asserting accreditation.
criteria.not_yet_fil: Itinuturing na automatic approval ang rekomendasyon o credential, hindi natutukoy ang kulang na impormasyon, o nangangako ng akreditasyon mula sa card lamang.
criteria.not_yet_en: Treats a recommendation or credential as automatic approval, cannot identify missing information, or promises accreditation from the card alone.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tamang papel, alam/kulang na impormasyon at tiyak na tanong sa opisyal na pasya/tala at susunod na hakbang, nang walang untag o pag-aangkin ng status.
levels.kaya_na_en: Accurate roles, known/missing information and a specific question about the official decision/record and next step, without prompts or status claims.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang direksiyon ngunit kailangan ng untag upang ihiwalay ang rekomendasyon sa pasya, tukuyin ang kulang o gawing tiyak ang lokal na tanong.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Correct direction but needs prompts to distinguish recommendation from decision, identify the gap or make the local question specific.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi pa naihihiwalay ang papel at pasya, nagpapasya mula sa label o rekomendasyon, o hindi pa matukoy ang kulang at tamang tanong.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Cannot yet distinguish roles and decisions, decides from a label or recommendation, or cannot identify the gap and appropriate question.

fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: maayos na follow-up.
en: Explain and apply in a situation: following up constructively.

criteria.observable_fil: Ihiwalay ang alam sa unknown, bumuo ng specific question sa tamang contact, ulitin at linawin ang sagot, at tukuyin ang bounded next step.
criteria.observable_en: Distinguish facts from unknowns, form a specific question through the appropriate contact, repeat and clarify the response, and identify a bounded next step.
criteria.not_yet_fil: Patuloy na ipinapalagay ang approval o sanhi, o wala pang specific question at clarification matapos ang suporta; magmodelo at ulitin.
criteria.not_yet_en: Still assumes approval or cause, or cannot yet form a specific question and clarification after support; model and repeat.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipapakita ang lahat ng kilos sa dalawang staff card nang walang prompt.
levels.kaya_na_en: Demonstrates every action on two staff cards without prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tamang direksiyon, may prompt sa facts, question, clarification o next step.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Sound direction, with prompts for facts, question, clarification or next step.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: May unconfirmed assumption o kulang na question/clarification matapos ang suporta; kailangan ng model at re-practice.
levels.hindi_pa_en: An unconfirmed assumption or missing question/clarification remains after support; needs modelling and re-practice.
